newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: MEDIENOS SEES 4 MLN LITAS 1997 PROFIT.
newsitem.headline: MEDIENOS SEES 4 MLN LITAS 1997 PROFIT.

text.p: Lithuanian cardboard maker Medienos Plaushas is targetting a four million litas net profit for 1997 after a 1.659 million litas 1996 audited net profit.
"The company had net profit of 1.3 million litas in the first four months," company director general Petras Chesna said during a presentation at the stock market late Thursday.
The company has reported a first quarter profit of 830,000 litas and sales of 11.1 million litas.

Chesna also said the company's investment program will amount to 20.3 million litas, eight million litas from a new share issue, 12 million litas from a seven-year bank credit and 300,000 litas from company funds.
He also said that 16 million litas will be invested to upgrade corrugated paperboard processing and another four million litas into the production line of egg containers.
The company said it had a monopoly in egg container production in the Baltics and is the biggest corrugated paperboard producer in Lithuania.
The company said it had 40 percent of the local corrugated paperboard market.
It also said that 60 percent of its products were sold in Lithuania, 20 percent in Latvia and Estonia, 13 percent in western Europe and seven percent in CIS countries.
Medienos Plaushas is one of the three corporates registered on the official list of Vilnius bourse.
